clusters.pick_reason: PR #2778 makes a narrower, more focused change: it adds only the try/except block and preserves the original `# pragma: no cover` annotations on both sse and streamable-http branches. PR #2745 also swaps `# pragma: no cover` to `# pragma: no branch` on the streamable-http case — a secondary, unrelated pragma change that conflates two concerns. #2778's title ('Suppress KeyboardInterrupt tracebacks from MCPServer.run') also more accurately describes the fix, since the catch applies to all three transports, not just stdio.
